notes: Adapted from the fork's shared mage default (ui/mage/apls/p1.apl.json), which is the Fire branch of a package that falls back to Frostbolt for non-Fire specs. Fix round 1: the stack-gate condition was reading Fire Vulnerability (22959), a real spellconst entry -- but the engine's own Improved Scorch implementation (sim/core/debuffs.go's ImprovedScorchAura) hardcodes the debuff's ActionID to spell 12873, and 22959 is never referenced anywhere in the engine's Go source outside an unused generated-constants table. Because the condition previously checked an aura the engine never creates, it was permanently true and Scorch was cast on every single GCD forever, and Fireball -- the actual damage filler -- and the Combustion pop were never reached; this is now fixed by gating on 12873, the id the engine actually registers the debuff under. 12873 has no entry anywhere in this build's spellconst, so this file now names an id the automated spellconst check cannot confirm; that is a known, deliberate exception for this one condition (per the fix-round-1 controller ruling), not an oversight, pending the engine/data lanes reconciling why the client build's own copy of Improved Scorch's debuff is not represented under any id there. Its Fireball and Frostbolt references were also stale ranks (10) where the build's current top ranks are 12 (25306) and 11 (25304) respectively; Frostbolt is dropped entirely since this file is Fire-specific and never falls back to it. Fire Blast is added on cooldown as a free extra nuke per community guides, which the shared preset omitted. Every other rank named here is checked against the spellconst of the newest client build in builds/.

priorityList.notes: Pop Combustion once Improved Scorch's debuff is fully stacked, for a guaranteed run of Fire crits. Fix round 1: tracks the engine's own debuff id (12873, sim/core/debuffs.go's ImprovedScorchAura), not the client's Fire Vulnerability (22959) the preset's stale reference resembled -- 12873 is not in spellconst, a flagged engine/data reconciliation gap, not an authoring error.
Scorch to apply or refresh the five stacks of Improved Scorch's debuff before it falls off.
Fire Blast on cooldown as a free extra nuke that does not compete for Scorch or Fireball casts.
Fireball is the primary filler once Improved Scorch's debuff is up.
